name: Typography Stagger Words

behavior.description: Existing word hooks rise and fade into their authored positions sequentially in stable reading order. Do not split or replace authored text.
behavior.targetSelection: Animate every existing word hook in the selected component. Use ascending numeric data-index when all hooks provide unique indices; otherwise use source DOM order captured at setup. Never use random order or visual positions measured during playback.
behavior.staggerTiming: The duration is the active duration of each word. For N present word hooks, word i starts at i * 0.09 seconds, using zero-based stable rank i. Total duration is 0.45 + max(0, N - 1) * 0.09 seconds; reserve that finite total in the containing scene. Earlier words hold their final pose while later words enter.
behavior.keyframeTiming: at is seconds relative to each word's staggered start; each keyframe's easing applies to the next interval.

adaptation: Translation uses design pixels at 1080x1920 scaled with the frame; rotation is additive degrees and scale multiplies each word's authored base scale. Opacity is absolute. Preserve scatter-variant rotations, line breaks, alignment, and text semantics through a layout-preserving motion layer. Apply each initial state at the motion start and keep not-yet-started words at it; reconstruct states deterministically when seeking rather than relying on previous playback. A single word is valid and requires no delay.
